description: Implementation of ProductOptionValueDao for accessing product option values in the database, including methods for listing, retrieving by ID, name, and code, with store and language filtering.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for ProductOptionValue entity, providing database access methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists product option values for a specific store and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Lists product option values for a store and language, excluding display-only options.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a product option value by ID for a specific store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Finds product option values by name within a store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product option value by code for a specific store.
